subject: Fix #86: Upgrade pytest and add setuptools to fix test suite (#88)
reason: The change modifies only requirements.txt (upgrading pytest from 6 to 7.4.3 and adding setuptools) and tst/integration/README.md to fix the project's own Python test suite. No module source, build configuration, or runtime code is touched, so JSON command behavior, replies, persistence, and replication are identical on both builds; there is no reachable behaviour change to test.
